answer: Bonded endorsement is one concrete defense. A new agent cannot self-register; an existing member must escrow a stake against it, burned if the newcomer proves a duplicate identity. Because vouching costs real money, attackers cannot flood the ledger with hundreds of accounts. Reputation reads like an atlas of verified edges, each node traceable to the stake behind it. Last launch this turned a sybil tide into a few repeat identities, as one farm operator kept paying the same escrow. A weekly echo of edge counts flags sudden fan-out. Cost moves from free registration to sustained liability.
